nodes.label: withdraw_provider_return preflights before the ORAO CPI: an owner share that cannot be delivered to the bound destination is refused fee-only (RefundNotDeliverable) with Client, request and eligibility/owner-refundable counters untouched; book_return always pays the owner share; provider returns are never re-locked into the spendable owner partition
nodes.rationale: IMPL-45 after Codex's targeted review of 366df88 (pre-settlement re-lock was a DR-14 violation: book_locked_rent could spend the refund). RED on ELF fc2c7940… (return accepted and re-locked) → GREEN on the IMPL-45 ELF; close-suite row undeliverable_owner_share_is_refused_before_the_cpi_and_retried_once_the_destination_is_funded; owner_refund.rs deferred_remainder_is_delivered_after_finalize.

impl2026_10_14_m7_owner_refund_deferral.label: Undeliverable owner refunds are deferred at TERMINAL SETTLEMENT only, never forfeited: credit_is_deliverable := c + a ≥ rent minimum; settle_books keeps the owner remainder in locked_owner_remaining of the settled close; permissionless deliver_owner_refund() pays it to the immutable destination exactly once (6050 NothingDeferred, 6051 RefundNotDeliverable; event OwnerRefundDelivered). Provider returns are NOT deferred: withdraw_provider_return refuses an undeliverable owner share before the CPI (IMPL-45).
impl2026_10_14_m7_owner_refund_deferral.rationale: Commit 366df88 (IMPL-43) narrowed by IMPL-45 after Codex's targeted review: terminal deferral in the permanent CloseRecord + permissionless immutable-destination delivery accepted in principle; spendable provider refunds rejected and removed. LiteSVM 0.7.1 does not check rent state for data-less accounts, so the predicate is validated against the Agave rule text.
